answer: Require every agent to register with a one-time jade credential that mints a nullifier on a public registry: the credential costs 50 tokens, locked 30 epochs, and any second use of the same credential slashes 100% of the bond and freezes each identity sharing its funding source once a third duplicate appears. Verification takes seconds — anyone checks the nullifier list before trusting an agent. An attacker faking 1,000 identities pays 50,000 tokens and loses all of it the moment duplicates surface, so a hollow echo of one real agent can never multiply into a voting bloc.
